traceability.notes: docs/stories/002.0-DEV-ESLINT-CONFIG.story.md describes ESLint configuration presets, flat config support, customizable rule options, and documentation requirements. The implementation in src/index.ts exports recommended and strict flat-config presets as arrays containing rule severity mappings designed to be spread into user flat configs after plugin registration, and this behavior is verified by FlatESLint integration tests. Rule modules such as src/rules/valid-story-reference.ts and src/rules/require-story-annotation.ts define JSON Schema-based meta.schema entries that support configurable options and reject unknown or invalid properties; tests in tests/config/eslint-config-validation.test.ts and tests/config/require-story-annotation-config.test.ts confirm correct schema structure and that ESLint surfaces clear validation errors. Documentation in README.md and user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md provides detailed ESLint v9 flat-config setup instructions, examples for JS, TS, mixed projects, monorepos, and troubleshooting guidance. All referenced tests for this story pass in the current Jest run. Collectively, this shows all acceptance criteria and listed requirements for Story 002.0-DEV-ESLINT-CONFIG are fully implemented.
